# UpstreamSync

> Julia tooling that keeps the JuliaGiac forks (main = pristine upstream tree tagged upstream/X.Y.Z, dev = our fork) in sync with Bernard Parisse's Giac release tarballs: check for releases, import a tarball as a tagged commit, plan the merge into dev, export our fixes as GitHub commit links.

Command line: `julia --project=. bin/upstream-sync.jl <command>`; exit status 0 = ok/up to date, 1 = error, 10 = new upstream release. Nothing is ever pushed.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://github.com/JuliaGiac/upstream-sync/blob/main/docs/src/index.md): purpose, the main/dev convention, installation
- [Commands](https://github.com/JuliaGiac/upstream-sync/blob/main/docs/src/commands.md): check, import, merge-plan, export and exit status
- [Release procedure](https://github.com/JuliaGiac/upstream-sync/blob/main/docs/src/release.md): step by step, from the weekly issue to dev
- [Configuration](https://github.com/JuliaGiac/upstream-sync/blob/main/docs/src/configuration.md): upstreams.toml keys and environment
- [API](https://github.com/JuliaGiac/upstream-sync/blob/main/docs/src/api.md): Julia functions and result types

## Optional

- [Configuration file](https://github.com/JuliaGiac/upstream-sync/blob/main/upstreams.toml): the configured upstreams
